description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams' used for filtering internationalization translation search results within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties and methods specific to translation filtering criteria such as language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and translation status.

classes.name: I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters used during searching of internationalization translation entries, including language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and whether only translated entries should be included.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used for filtering translations.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID for filtering translations.

methods.name: getSourceText
methods.description: Retrieves the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: setSourceText
methods.description: Sets the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: getTranslatedText
methods.description: Retrieves the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: setTranslatedText
methods.description: Sets the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Gets the group ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the group ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Checks if only translated entries are being filtered.

methods.name: setOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only translated entries.
